name: Free-TV/IPTV
role: Broad community baseline with a small Japanese terrestrial section; verify each stream because stale entries return an interstitial.

name: iptv-org/iptv
role: Large cross-country catalog. Useful for official FAST and news streams, but not a complete Japanese terrestrial source.

name: skinred78/jp-iptv-epg
role: Large Japanese aggregation used by the original recommendation. It mixes a reliable NHK G feed with many stale Render relays.

name: MrKagesan/JP-IPTV
role: Broad Japanese terrestrial, BS, and CS aggregation. Its first-level playlist is available, but several child manifests returned 403 during the 2026-10-08 Home test.

name: rloim024/IPTV-jp
role: Broad Japanese aggregation with good nominal channel coverage. Most primary lines share the same third-party relay, so this is a coverage baseline rather than an independent source.

name: Jsan-PC/IPTV_JP
role: Utako-derived Japanese aggregation with many aliases. Treat repeated URLs as one upstream rather than separate fallbacks.

name: koneMorris1625/iptvNippon
role: Primehome-heavy Japanese aggregation. Useful for testing the primehome upstream separately from community mirrors.

name: DimaSvitenko2009/IPTV-JP
role: Small Primehome-heavy list retained as a historical baseline. Upstream activity is stale.

name: ytpit20218/Japan-IPTV
role: Old luongz-derived list. Numeric IP streams are useful only as a legacy comparison and require separate Home validation.

name: tocotoco0013/japan-iptv-m3u8
role: Disabled after returning 404 during the 2026-10-08 baseline pass.

name: vovanlocpro/IPTV-JPN
role: Disabled because the published playlist resolves to a single generic Utako entry and does not cover the curated channels.
